system_description.narrative_title: AI‑Semiconductor Cold War: Tech, Trade & Supply‑Chain Realignment
system_description.narrative_summary: News in this window is dominated by an accelerating strategic competition anchored in AI compute and semiconductors that is reshaping markets, trade policy and logistics. Corporate profits, record IPO ambitions and Wall Street financing (e.g., Nvidia, Anthropic, SMIC, Lenovo) sit alongside government measures — tariffs, export controls, trade negotiations and military posture — aimed at securing critical technology, minerals and routes. The interaction produces reinforcing feedbacks (investment → capacity → market dominance → policy reaction) and contested global flows of capital, goods and data.
system_description.scope: Actors (tech firms, chipmakers, investors, governments, navies), material stocks (fabs, data centres, batteries, rare earths, shipping assets, satellites), flows (capital, AI models, chips, minerals, goods, information), policy levers and events (tariffs, export controls, IPOs, military drills, Arctic shipping routes) that connect technology, finance, trade and security.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-economic order (US‑China strategic rivalry embedded within international trade, finance and security institutions).
adjacent_subsystems: Manufacturing & logistics supply chains (semiconductors, EVs, data centres)
Energy & critical minerals (lithium, rare earths, water access)
Cyber/security and military posture (Taiwan, naval drills, export controls)
evidence_headlines: Everybody loves Nvidia — but then, they can’t afford not to
Anthropic investors bet on $2tn valuation in record IPO
SMIC profit more than triples on AI-driven chip demand
Trump Announces Drone Tariffs to Bolster U.S. Supply Chains and Counter China
China bypasses shipping chokepoints with ‘Ice Silk Road’ through Arctic
US accuses more than 40 countries of helping China avoid Trump’s tariffs

variables.name: AI compute demand rate
variables.description: The rate at which compute capacity is consumed for training and running large AI models and applications.

variables.name: Semiconductor fabrication capacity
variables.description: The available installed production capability of advanced semiconductor fabrication facilities measured in wafer starts or equivalent output.

variables.name: AI-critical chip inventory levels
variables.description: The on-hand stock of processors and components used for AI systems across manufacturers, distributors and customers.

variables.name: High‑tech investment flow
variables.description: The rate of capital allocation into AI, semiconductor manufacturing, data centres and related technology projects from public and private sources.

variables.name: Tech financing liquidity
variables.description: The availability and cost of equity and debt funding for firms and projects in AI and semiconductor sectors.

variables.name: Export control intensity
variables.description: The severity and scope of policy measures restricting cross‑border transfer of technology, equipment and components.

variables.name: Tariff and trade barrier level
variables.description: The overall level of tariffs, quotas and non‑tariff trade barriers affecting the flow of tech goods and inputs.

variables.name: Supply‑chain diversification
variables.description: The degree to which sourcing, production and logistics are spread across multiple suppliers, regions and routes.

variables.name: Shipping route openness
variables.description: The accessibility and reliability of major maritime and polar shipping corridors for commercial cargo movement.

variables.name: Military/logistics pressure
variables.description: The intensity of military presence, exercises and security measures that affect commercial logistics and freedom of navigation.

variables.name: Critical mineral supply risk
variables.description: The vulnerability of supply chains for scarce minerals and materials (e.g., lithium, rare earths) to disruption or constraint.

variables.name: Data flow restriction level
variables.description: The degree of legal, technical and policy constraints on cross‑border data transfers and access to distributed datasets.

variables.name: Tech talent mobility
variables.description: The rate and ease with which skilled personnel in AI and semiconductor fields move between organizations and jurisdictions.

variables.name: Cyber attack activity level
variables.description: The frequency and sophistication of cyber intrusions and AI‑enabled offensive operations targeting technology infrastructure and IP.

variables.name: Market concentration in critical tech
variables.description: The degree to which production, design and platform provision for key technologies are dominated by a small number of actors or clusters.

variables.name: Manufacturing onshoring rate
variables.description: The rate at which production capacity and value‑chain activities are relocated from foreign to domestic locations.

catalysts.title: Anthropic blockbuster IPO
catalysts.description: A likely large IPO from Anthropic (valuations near $2tn reported) that would unlock capital, solidify market position and fund rapid AI expansion. Market debut or IPO roadshow expected in the near term.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines: 'Anthropic’s anticipated $2tn IPO', 'Anthropic Tries to Shore Up Investor Confidence Ahead of Blockbuster IPO'.

catalysts.title: Nvidia-led AI financing and data‑center buildout
catalysts.description: Large financing vehicles and deals (Wall Street partners, Nvidia’s data‑center guarantees and investments) mobilize capital for cloud/AI infrastructure and chip purchases.
catalysts.rationale: 'Wall Street giants partner with Nvidia on $500bn AI financing deal', 'Nvidia discloses $21bn stake in SpaceX', 'Nvidia cuts planned OpenAI data center guarantee'.

catalysts.title: August 19 tariff deadline / U.S. trade push
catalysts.description: An imminent U.S. tariff deadline and related trade negotiations (references to Aug 19) that will raise tariffs or force trade deals, spurring rerouting, transshipment scrutiny and supply responses.
catalysts.rationale: 'US also wants trade deal before August 19 tariff deadline', 'Trump Announces Drone Tariffs', 'White House Says China Avoids Billions in Tariffs by Rerouting Goods'.

catalysts.title: Arctic 'Ice Silk Road' shipping expansion
catalysts.description: China's scaling of regular cargo routes through the Arctic (Ice Silk Road) that will re-route trade flows, open new corridors and provoke strategic responses.
catalysts.rationale: 'China bypasses shipping chokepoints with ‘Ice Silk Road’ through Arctic', 'China is winning the race for the Ice Silk Road', 'A reality check is needed on Arctic shipping'.

catalysts.title: Escalating Taiwan military drills and AI cyber attacks
catalysts.description: Ongoing Taiwan annual drills, stepped-up maritime pressure and reported AI-driven hacking campaigns targeting Taiwan, likely to continue and escalate regional disruption.
catalysts.rationale: 'Taiwan holds naval drill during war games', 'China-linked hackers hit Taiwan', 'Taiwan says it was targeted last month in AI-driven hacking campaign'.

catalysts.title: U.S. pressure on Apple to avoid Chinese memory chips
catalysts.description: U.S. government urging Apple and others to avoid Chinese memory suppliers amid shortages, likely to change procurement and sourcing decisions in coming months.
catalysts.rationale: 'US presses Apple to avoid Chinese memory chips amid shortage', 'Exclusive | U.S. Urges Apple Not to Buy Chinese Memory Chips'.

catalysts.title: SMIC / Chinese chipmakers expand output and raise prices
catalysts.description: Chinese foundries report strong AI-driven demand, price increases and shipment gains that will alter capacity and regional supply dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: 'SMIC profit more than triples on AI-driven chip demand', 'SMIC increases prices on strong AI demand', 'This Chinese firm has topped Micron and Kioxia in shipments'.

catalysts.title: Risk of renewed Chinese rare‑earth export controls
catalysts.description: Price spikes and reporting indicate market fear of Chinese export controls on niche rare earths, which could trigger supply shocks or policy responses.
catalysts.rationale: 'Price of niche rare earth jumps on fears of renewed Chinese export controls', 'The west has given China the keys to the medicine cabinet'.
